rules.rationale: Source ESOL prior for smiles_short was +6.89 (n=261); compact solutes pay little cavity-formation cost.
Source smiles_mid effect -6.61 (n=226), damped because the length role confidence is only 0.22.
Strongest source value prior (-11.46, confidence 0.47): bulky lipophilic solutes lose solvation favorability.
Donor-to-heteroatom role (transfer weight 0.51); multiple O/N centers add favorable water hydrogen bonds.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers the ESOL size ordering with a moderate heteroatom tilt, restoring the configuration that led on generation-0 seeds while the target anchor takes over late. Fails if hydration favors large polar solutes.

rules.rationale: Ring role carries the highest source transfer weight (0.76); cyclic solutes expose polarizable surface with modest cavity cost.
Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence (0.27) source smiles_mid penalty, since mid-size solutes accumulate hydration sites.
Solutes with neither heteroatoms nor halogens offer no polar contacts; cavity formation dominates hydration.
Polyhalogenated solutes hydrogen bond weakly and are bulky, a classic hydrophobic hydration penalty.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration ranking is set by ring and polar-contact chemistry rather than raw length, so the weak mid-length penalty is reversed. Fails if short saturated solutes actually dominate the score.

state.lesson: In both development generations the source-derived length-prior skill outranked its mechanistic rival on matched seeds, but absolute AUC differed strongly across seed blocks, so cross-generation drops should not be read as parameter effects; revert toward the best matched-seed configuration instead of over-damping.
state.revision_summary: Restored the generation-0 heteroatom weight (0.35), prior_scale (0.30) and semantic mass (0.42/0.14) for the winning length-prior transfer, with slightly more early exploration. Replaced the compact-apolar counter with a ring-role counter-hypothesis that exploits the highest-weight unused source role, reverses the weak mid-length penalty, and keeps mechanistic hydrocarbon and polyhalogen penalties under light semantic mass. Deployed the restored length-prior transfer.
